name: loan-agent

dependencies.name: library-api
dependencies.description: Fetch the signed-in member's own loans to answer their question from.

description: Answers a member's plain-language question about their own loans (due dates, borrowing history) using only that member's real loan records from library-api, fetched on behalf of the signed-in caller. Does not answer about other members' loans, does not create or modify loans, and does not produce mood-based suggestions.
